snippet.title: The official trailer for Version 1.7 "Blue Tears Season" is now live!
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Version 1.7 "Blue Tears Season" is now live!
♾️Blue Tears, Blue Tears, secrets kept, in guarded years.
Upstream I drift, soft and light,
to yesterday's fading plight...
Version 1.7 of Infinity Nikki "Blue Tears Season" will launch on July 7 (UTC-7)!
Get ready for new events, a new dungeon... and so much more! Stylists, don't miss out on the excitement—dive in and explore!

——

Infinity Nikki Version 1.6 "Playful Season" launches globally on June 12th (UTC-7)!
